# Research sources used for v1.9.0 tuning

The implementation uses these sources as qualitative physical guidance, not as
sample material or a claim of exact acoustic reproduction:

- NASA NTRS: launch acoustics separate transient ignition overpressure from
  longer-duration jet/plume noise.
- NASA NTRS: rocket plume acoustic radiation is broadband and directional.
- Dillon Aero M134D product data: electrically driven 7.62 mm Gatling system,
  fixed 3,000 rounds/minute (50 rounds/second).
- U.S. TRADOC descriptions of RPG-7 propulsion, summarized in public technical
  references: booster launch, delayed sustainer motor and slow fin-induced spin.
